pull_request.title: Calorimeter: prepare digitization model reuse and isolated Si-W prototype
pull_request.head: codex/issue117-calorimeter-digitization
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Refs #117. Adds the calorimeter model survey and an isolated, opt-in Si–W digitization prototype that reuses pinned original MarlinReco energy methods. **The Marlin study and original-framework/physics validation remain deferred at the user's request until appropriate software is installed.** This draft does not close #117 or claim design acceptance.

## Change

- Draft DES-044 compares existing models for Si–W, LAr, SiPM-on-tile HCAL and quartz-fibre FCAL, with pinned sources, framework coupling, licensing and μ=200 gaps.
- Connect the ACTS skeleton to the original silicon energy kernel through a separate GPL executable; preserve explicit position modes, deterministic event seeds and signal/noise provenance.
- Prepare a same-hit comparison utility and a source-verified Key4hep steering recipe for later execution.
- Retain reproduction recipes, project tracking and session evidence. Existing exploratory plots and compact binwise summaries are included; full ROOT samples, caches and run logs remain local.

## Existing exploratory previews

These electron/muon plots were prepared **before the Marlin-study deferral**. This update publishes the saved summaries without running new transport, digitization or a full-framework comparison. The original Marlin/Key4hep study remains deferred.

### Electron response and relative energy spread

[![Exploratory electron response and relative energy spread](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/response.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/response.png)

200 electron events at each of 5, 20 and 50 GeV and η = 0, 1 and 2 (1,800 events). Energies are deposit-equivalent, with no shower calibration. RMS error bars use a Gaussian approximation; forward tails remain unqualified. The CALICE curve provides scale context for a different geometry, not a validation band.

### Held-out muon MIP spectrum

[![Held-out central muon MIP spectrum](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/mip.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/mip.png)

250 held-out central 10 GeV muon events. The 148.75 keV MIP scale was frozen from a separate 250-event calibration sample. These are binned spectra, without a Landau–Gaussian fit or angular/systematic validation.

[Compact binwise data](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/binwise.json) · [Replotting recipe and limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/README.md#existing-exploratory-previews)

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Updated project tracking and retained DRAFT/PROTOTYPE approval boundaries; detector geometry/layout is unaffected.
- [x] Six native CTest suites passed, including eight silicon cases, existing ROOT I/O and synthetic comparator corruption checks.
- [x] Session records, project records, token-site build and whitespace checks passed during preparation.
- [x] Audited all new Git objects: no ROOT/NPZ/LCIO samples, build trees or reference caches enter this PR.
- [x] Added `interactions/pr-0118.json`, linked both canonical session records, and validated the interaction ledger.

The signed-noise software fixture measured RMS 0.200103546 MIP for configured 0.2 MIP, with 4,518 entries above 0.4 MIP versus 4,550.026 expected over 200,000 draws. This is a unit fixture, not detector noise qualification. The reference utility tests use synthetic controls; no original full-framework comparison is claimed.

See [preparation report](docs/validation/issue117/README.md), [DES-044](docs/design/DES-044-calorimeter-digitization.md) and [deferred reference recipe](software/analysis/calorimeter_digitization/reference.md).

issues.title: Calorimeter: select existing digitization models and validate a first implementation
issues.body:
## Goal
Reuse existing, validated calorimeter digitization models rather than writing our
own. Survey candidates for every calorimeter technology on `main`, then implement
and validate one end to end in the `CalorimeterDigitizationAlgorithm` skeleton.

Technologies: Si-W ECAL (DES-031), ALLEGRO-style LAr ECAL (DES-032/033),
steel/scintillator SiPM-on-tile HCAL (DES-036–038), W/quartz-fibre FCAL (DES-039).

## Starting leads (verify paths and versions)
- ATLAS Athena: `LArDigitization`, `LArROD` (OFC), `CaloTools` noise, `TileSimAlgs`
- CMS CMSSW: `HGCalSimProducers` (HGCDigitizer), HGCAL Si/scintillator noise maps,
  `HcalSimAlgos` (SiPM, HF), `SimG4CMS/Calo` (HF fibres)
- FCC-ee/Key4hep: `k4RecCalorimeter` (ALLEGRO cells, noise, calibration), HEP-FCC `dual-readout`
- ILD/CLIC: MarlinReco `DDCaloDigi`, `RealisticCaloDigiSilicon` / `RealisticCaloDigiScinPpd`
- EIC: EICrecon `CalorimeterHitDigi` (EDM4hep-native generic baseline)

ALLEGRO and ILD target low-pileup e+e−; note what each model needs for 14 TeV, μ=200
(pulse shape and out-of-time pileup for LAr, radiation-dependent noise for Si/SiPM).

## Scope
1. Survey: per technology, candidate model(s), effects covered (sampling fraction,
   Birks/photostatistics, SiPM saturation, noise, pulse shape, out-of-time pileup,
   ADC/ToA, thresholds), framework coupling and reuse effort.
2. Implement the recommended model for the **Si-W ECAL first**, using ODD's ECAL
   (same technology family) so it runs on existing ODD `ddsim` samples.
3. Validate:
   - **Unit:** noise-only events reproduce configured noise RMS and threshold rates;
     single muons give the expected MIP peak.
   - **Reference comparison:** same `ddsim` hits through the original implementation
     (e.g. Key4hep `DDCaloDigi` / `k4RecCalorimeter`) and ours agree.
   - **Physics:** single e/γ at several energies and η give sampling fraction,
     linearity and resolution consistent in scale with published Si-W results.

The EDM4hep input converter currently needs a cellID → cell-centre lookup; `ddsim`
hits already carry the cell position, so an option to use it is in scope.

The Si-W implementation is a **PROTOTYPE** until the DES is signed off.

## Done when
- [ ] DES draft recommending one model per technology, with references and open questions
- [ ] Si-W ECAL digitization implemented with unit and reference-comparison tests passing
- [ ] Single-particle response plots with recipe (binwise outputs only, per ADR-003)
- [ ] Follow-up issues listed for the remaining technologies

CaloTech prepared DES-044 before physical implementation, surveying six pinned
primary software sources and recommending chains for all four technologies.
The main agent integrated source records and CALICE comparator evidence into
the canonical source manifest. SoftEng reused original Marlin silicon energy
methods in a separate GPL executable, leaving the ACTS library interface MPL.
The explicit prototype includes cell aggregation, signed Gaussian noise checks,
strict thresholds, deterministic event seeds, opt-in stored cell positions and
noise-only output without fabricated truth. The absence of a full original
runtime remains a blocker for the issue's reference gate, not for preparing
reviewable code or running the available ODD simulation.

The first half of 500 central 10GeV muons freezes a 148.75keV empirical binned
MIP scale; the second half is held out. No fitted/path-aware MIP acceptance is
claimed. Shower generation uses full unchanged ODD. Only compact binwise
counts, plots and reproduction recipes are intended for Git.
